content.text:
Fix these linter errors:
cmd/entire/cli/vercelconfig/vercelconfig.go:75:15: G304: Potential file inclusion via variable (gosec)
        data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
                     ^
cmd/entire/cli/vercelconfig/vercelconfig.go:140:3: error is not nil (line 138) but it returns nil (nilerr)
                return rootTreeHash, nil
                ^
cmd/entire/cli/strategy/common_test.go:1167:1: unnecessary trailing newline (whitespace)
}
^
cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/committed.go:1445:9: error returned from external package is unwrapped: sig: func github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/vercelconfig.MaybeMergeMetadataBranchConfig(repo *github.com/go-git/go-git/v6.Repository, rootTreeHash github.com/go-git/go-git/v6/plumbing.Hash) (github.com/go-git/go-git/v6/plumbing.Hash, error) (wrapcheck)
        return vercelconfig.MaybeMergeMetadataBranchConfig(s.repo, rootTreeHash)
               ^
cmd/entire/cli/vercelconfig/vercelconfig.go:45:10: error returned from external package is unwrapped: sig: func github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/settings.Load(ctx context.Context) (*github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/settings.EntireSettings, error) (wrapcheck)
                return err
I’m inspecting the flagged files first so I can make the smallest lint-safe fixes and then verify with targeted checks.

I have the exact callsites now. Next step is patching the linter issues directly in `vercelconfig`, the checkpoint wrapper, and the test whitespace, then I’ll run a focused lint pass on those packages.
I found a real bug along with the lint: `MaybeMergeMetadataBranchConfig` can dereference `projectSettings` when `CachedSettings()` fails. I’m fixing that instead of silencing the warning.
I’ve narrowed the remaining work to three code edits and one formatting cleanup. After that I’ll run `golangci-lint` against just these packages to confirm the warnings are gone.
The patch is in. I’m waiting on a targeted `golangci-lint` run over the touched packages to make sure nothing else regressed.

- wrapped the `settings.Load` error in `InitSettings`

- removed the trailing blank line in the test file
